svg.title: Shopped workflow (light)

g.aria-label: Add what you need for the week.
Move bought items into the cart.
Use Low, Full, or exact amounts.
Scale servings and use your ingredients.
Pantry-to-shopping suggestions require the optional Shopping and pantry setting.

svg.desc: Plan a shopping list, shop and check items, track pantry amounts, then choose and cook a recipe. Shopping and pantry suggestions require opting in.
